A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salt-Grilled Fish can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Fish]] together with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default version can only be made either by using [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]], both of which offer no status effects, or by using two Fish with contradictory effects. Eating these Fish will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. To make them, the whole Fish must be rolled in [[Rock Salt]] before it is grilled. Based on both the type of Fish used and whether any additional [[Ingredient]]s are added, several different variations of Salt-Grilled Fish can be made: * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]] if he eats these fish. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. They can be eaten to completely replenish and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es or other energizing Ingredients. Consuming them will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty Ingredients. Link's movement speed will be increased by eating these meals. * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Bass]], or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], or other mighty Ingredients. By eating this fish, Link will receive a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. If Link eats them, he will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. One level of [[Heat Resistance]] will be granted to Link if he eats them. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Fish}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A simple dish made by rolling a whole fish in natural rock salt before grilling it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], or other tough Ingredients. They will grant Link a boost to his defense if he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Salt-Grilled Fish return in {{TotK}}, and their [[Recipe]] still consists of [[Cooking]] any type of [[Fish]] with [[Rock Salt]]. Their default version can be made by using a [[Hyrule Bass]], a [[Sanke Carp]], or an [[Ancient Arowana]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fish Pie * Fish Skewer * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
